description: A radar chart drawn over circular grid rings instead of polygons.
overview: A `RadarChart` whose `PolarGrid` uses `gridType="circle"`, with one filled `Radar` series. `chartData` has one record per axis (`skill`) with `thisMonth` and `lastMonth` scores. Only `thisMonth` is drawn. Pressing the chart shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records, set `PolarAngleAxis` `dataKey` to your axis field, and rename the series in `chartConfig`. The component takes no props.
